Credit outstanding also contracted by Rs 2.52 lakh crore during the same period. Consequently, credit growth decreased to 18.2% from 19.4% in the prior fortnight. Meanwhile, deposit growth recorded a decline to 16.7% compared to 17.8%. The overall outstanding deposits reached Rs 278.76 lakh crore and outstanding credit was Rs 227.

banking-economy.title: RBI tightens leverage ratio rules, keeps minimum capital thresholds unchanged
banking-economy.summary: The RBI has tightened how banks calculate leverage by widening the measurement of derivatives, repo transactions and off-balance-sheet exposures, while retaining the minimum ratios at 4% for systemically important banks and 3.5% for others. The norms, effective April 1, 2027, also strengthen disclosure requirements and restrict the use of collateral and netting to reduce reported exposures.
